page.overview:
Who is Clione?

Clione is a member of the Heart Pirates.

Clione is a man of average size with brown hair, although only the bangs can be seen as his head is covered by a long dark blue blue hood that has a tip at the end. Like most members of the Heart Pirates, he wears a white boiler suit with the crew's Jolly Roger on the left breast.

Along with Ikkaku and Uni, Clione was against the idea of allying with the Straw Hat Pirates, thinking of their assistance as worthless.

Clione wields a sword, though has not been seen using it.
